name: authority-client-role-decision
title: Decide Koala CLI authority client role before enforce-mode implementation
description: Milestone 1 for the cross-end authority hardening roadmap. Before implementing CLI handshake, EvidenceEnvelope expansion, actor-key signing, runner heartbeat, or receipt gate consumption, Koala needs a product decision: should Koala CLI remain a thin local/shadow lifecycle client while Mac/runner/CI produce canonical authority evidence, or should Koala CLI become a first-class enforce-mode authority client accepted by Cord Team Python authority in production. This story is decision-only and must not modify production code.
